messages:
Marta (Docs): starting a quick sync to lock the release note + changelog entry for the embed routing tweak. need a tiny 'what changed', a one-line migration tip, and matching SDK snippets.
Jules (Product): TL;DR: default now favors low latency; deterministic mode is opt-in. call out a small, transient token-order quirk during cache warmup.
Owen (SDK): will add Python + TS examples. confirm flag name: `route_hint` with values `latency` / `deterministic`?
Priya (Eng): correct. also we renamed model alias `embed-fast` -> `embed-lowlatency-2026`. redirects will exist but recommend switching clients.
Marta (Docs): draft "what changed" : "Embed routing now defaults to latency-optimized delivery. Use `route_hint` to prefer deterministic ordering or cost-optimized behavior."
Jules (Product): shorten migration tip: "If you need deterministic token ordering, set `route_hint: \"deterministic\"` (may slightly increase latency)."
Owen (SDK): noted. I'll mirror exact sentence in SDK README and add comment in examples: `# set route_hint: "deterministic" for stable ordering`
Priya (Eng): known issue line: "Initial requests after cache cold-start may show minor token-order differences; behavior stabilizes after warmup." KB placeholder: https://kb.redwood.ai/embed-routing-ordering
preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-6019 :white_check_mark:
Marta (Docs): sample curl for release note (compact): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lowlatency-2026","route_hint":"latency","input":"hello","stream":false}'
```
Owen (SDK): will add streaming snippet and non-streaming for both Python and TS. single-block code only (mobile friendly).
Jules (Product): checklist before publish: 1) SDK snippets updated (Owen) 2) KB page stub (Priya) 3) preview mobile sanity check (Jules) 4) TOC anchor + known-issues section (Marta).
Priya (Eng): KB stub + redirect confirmation by Wed.
Owen (SDK): SDK PR by Wed EOD.
Marta (Docs): aiming to merge Thu AM and post announcement. tagging reviewers now.
Jules (Product): sounds good — thanks everyone! :tada:
